name: delix-local
description: Claude Code plugins: delix (orchestrator + role sessions + read-only reviewers) and its companion board, delix-board. Source is this repo. A GitHub install updates only when plugin.json's version changes: claude plugin marketplace update delix-local, then claude plugin update delix@delix-local. A local-path install is a cached copy too and updates the same way (claude plugin update after a version bump); claude --plugin-dir reads a folder in place.

plugins.name: delix
plugins.description: Team workflow: spec through a grill interview, task cards, worktree-isolated implementer sessions, qa/security review; two human gates.

plugins.name: delix-board
plugins.description: Companion mod for delix: a live board pane (cards, gates, long runs, metrics), a band above the prompt and toasts when a run ends. Read-only; idle in headless sessions.
